result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is one clear layout defect in the “Popular right now” section where the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line overlaps and becomes unreadable. Other items are minor truncation/scrolling artifacts rather than broken UI.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar”, the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine metadata are overlapping/garbled, rendering as something like “25–€0rdelivery” instead of separate readable tokens.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout by ensuring the time, delivery fee, and category are separate inline elements with proper spacing/wrapping, and prevent the “€0 delivery” badge or text from overlapping the row.

issues.description: The category filter row and restaurant carousels are clipped at the right edge, e.g. “Healthy” and the next category card are partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for horizontal scrolling, but add clearer edge fading, peek spacing, or scroll affordance so users understand more items are available.

issues.description: Restaurant names in horizontally scrolling cards are truncated, such as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths, two-line title wrapping, or ellipsis behavior that preserves enough identifying text.
